title: Easier paths through the forests
changes: Trees now only block their trunk, not a whole square: you round them smoothly and slip between trees that only touch at a corner.
The Whispering Woods and the Thornwood have winding ways through the undergrowth where tree clumps were thinned out.
Clicking to walk through a forest now takes a much more direct route, and a click right beside a trunk walks you there.
